lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你從捷運站出去，走到十字路口，再往右轉。
lines.simplified: 你从捷运站出去，走到十字路口，再往右转。

choices.alt: Turns left: on the phone map, the dotted route goes up to the crossroads and turns left to the red pin
Straight on: on the phone map, the dotted route goes straight across the crossroads to the red pin
Turns right: on the phone map, the dotted route goes up to the crossroads and turns right to the red pin

questions.why: 往右轉 means turn right: walk to the crossroads (十字路口), then (再) turn right. 往左轉 would be left.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 你從這裡出去，到了十字路口往左轉。
lines.simplified: 你从这里出去，到了十字路口往左转。

lines.english: Go out from here, and when you get to the crossroads, turn left.

choices.alt: Turns left: on the phone map, the dotted route goes up to the crossroads and turns left to the red pin
Straight on: on the phone map, the dotted route goes straight across the crossroads to the red pin
Turns right: on the phone map, the dotted route goes up to the crossroads and turns right to the red pin

questions.why: 往左轉 means turn left: when you get to the crossroads (到了十字路口), go left. 往右轉 would be right.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 從捷運站往前走，過了十字路口就是博物館。

lines.english: Walk straight ahead from the MRT station; just past the crossroads is the museum.

choices.alt: Turns left: on the phone map, the dotted route goes up to the crossroads and turns left to the red pin

Turns right: on the phone map, the dotted route goes up to the crossroads and turns right to the red pin

questions.why: 往前走 is straight ahead, and 過了十字路口 means once you have crossed the crossroads: there is no turn.

Four tickets: the ticket seller's hand passes four tickets out over the ticket counter

lines.traditional: 我們一共三個人，可是我已經有一張了。
lines.simplified: 我们一共三个人，可是我已经有一张了。

Four tickets: the ticket seller's hand passes four tickets out over the ticket counter

questions.why: The seller asks how many tickets they will buy (買幾張票). There are three of them (一共三個人), but he already has one (已經有一張了), so he buys two, not three.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我跟爸爸、媽媽還有妹妹都要買票。
lines.simplified: 我跟爸爸、妈妈还有妹妹都要买票。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gēn bàba, māma hái yǒu mèimei dōu yào mǎi piào.
lines.english: Dad, Mom, my little sister and I all need to buy tickets.

choices.alt: Two tickets: the ticket seller's hand passes two tickets out over the ticket counter
Three tickets: the ticket seller's hand passes three tickets out over the ticket counter
Four tickets: the ticket seller's hand passes four tickets out over the ticket counter

questions.why: Count the people: 我, 爸爸, 媽媽 and 妹妹 are four, and 都要買票 means they all need tickets.

picture.alt: Daytime at the top of a museum's front steps. The big golden doors are open and a few other visitors are walking in. Outside on the steps stand three people who are already there: a curly-haired boy with glasses in an orange sweater, a boy in a green hoodie with an open navy jacket over it, and the teacher in a blue cardigan. choices.simplified: 星期二下午三点可以来这里参观。
choices.pinyin: Xīngqí'èr xiàwǔ sān diǎn kěyǐ lái zhèlǐ cānguān.
choices.english: You can visit here at 3 p.m. on Tuesday.

choices.traditional: 星期六晚上七點可以來這裡參觀。
choices.simplified: 星期六晚上七点可以来这里参观。
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíliù wǎnshàng qī diǎn kěyǐ lái zhèlǐ cānguān.
choices.english: You can visit here at 7 p.m. on Saturday.

questions.why: The museum is open from 9:00 to 5:00 and closed only on Tuesdays (星期二不開門), so 10:00 on Monday is fine. On Tuesday it is closed, and at 7:00 in the evening it has been closed since 5:00.

versions.alt: A sign by a history museum's entrance with its opening hours, ticket prices and guided-talk times

transcript.traditional: 歷史博物館　上午9:00—下午5:00　星期二不開門　票 一張150元　學生票 一張100元　介紹時間 上午10:00、下午2:00
transcript.simplified: 历史博物馆　上午9:00—下午5:00　星期二不开门　票 一张150元　学生票 一张100元　介绍时间 上午10:00、下午2:00
transcript.pinyin: Lìshǐ Bówùguǎn: shàngwǔ 9:00—xiàwǔ 5:00; xīngqí'èr bù kāimén; piào yì zhāng 150 yuán; xuéshēng piào yì zhāng 100 yuán; jièshào shíjiān shàngwǔ 10:00, xiàwǔ 2:00
transcript.english: History Museum: 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.; closed on Tuesdays; tickets 150 each; student tickets 100 each; guided talks at 10:00 a.m. and 2:00 p.m.

prompt.traditional: 老師買一張票，三個學生買學生票，一共多少錢？
prompt.simplified: 老师买一张票，三个学生买学生票，一共多少钱？
prompt.pinyin: Lǎoshī mǎi yì zhāng piào, sān ge xuéshēng mǎi xuéshēng piào, yígòng duōshǎo qián?
prompt.english: The teacher buys one ticket, and three students buy student tickets. How much is that altogether?

questions.why: One ticket is 150元 and three student tickets are 3 × 100元: 150 + 300 = 450. 四百元 would be four student tickets, and 三百五十元 counts only two students.

versions.alt: A notice on the library door about the internet

transcript.traditional: 注意！　星期三 上午8:00—11:00　圖書館的網路不能用　電腦也不能上網　要上網的同學，請用自己的手機　11:00以後就沒問題了
transcript.simplified: 注意！　星期三 上午8:00—11:00　图书馆的网路不能用　电脑也不能上网　要上网的同学，请用自己的手机　11:00以后就没问题了
transcript.pinyin: Zhùyì! Xīngqísān shàngwǔ 8:00—11:00: túshūguǎn de wǎnglù bù néng yòng, diànnǎo yě bù néng shàngwǎng. Yào shàngwǎng de tóngxué, qǐng yòng zìjǐ de shǒujī. 11:00 yǐhòu jiù méi wèntí le.
transcript.english: Note! Wednesday 8:00–11:00 a.m.: the library internet can't be used, and the computers can't go online either. Students who need to go online, please use your own phones. After 11:00 it will be fine.

prompt.traditional: 哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which one is true?

choices.traditional: 星期三上午十點，在圖書館可以用電腦上網。
choices.simplified: 星期三上午十点，在图书馆可以用电脑上网。
choices.pinyin: Xīngqísān shàngwǔ shí diǎn, zài túshūguǎn kěyǐ yòng diànnǎo shàngwǎng.
choices.english: At 10 a.m. on Wednesday, you can go online with a computer in the library.

choices.traditional: 星期三上午十點，在圖書館可以用手機上網。
choices.simplified: 星期三上午十点，在图书馆可以用手机上网。
choices.pinyin: Xīngqísān shàngwǔ shí diǎn, zài túshūguǎn kěyǐ yòng shǒujī shàngwǎng.
choices.english: At 10 a.m. on Wednesday, you can go online with a phone in the library.

choices.traditional: 星期三上午十點，圖書館的網路沒有問題。
choices.simplified: 星期三上午十点，图书馆的网路没有问题。
choices.pinyin: Xīngqísān shàngwǔ shí diǎn, túshūguǎn de wǎnglù méiyǒu wèntí.
choices.english: At 10 a.m. on Wednesday, the library internet has no problems.

questions.why: The notice says 電腦也不能上網 (the computers can't go online either) but 要上網的同學，請用自己的手機: you can go online with your own phone. At ten the library internet is still down, so it is not 沒有問題.

transcript.traditional: 注意！　星期三 上午8:00—11:00　圖書館的網路不能用　電腦也不能上網　要上網的同學，請用自己的手機　11:00以後就沒問題了

transcript.pinyin: Zhùyì! Xīngqísān shàngwǔ 8:00—11:00: túshūguǎn de wǎnglù bù néng yòng, diànnǎo yě bù néng shàngwǎng. Yào shàngwǎng de tóngxué, qǐng yòng zìjǐ de shǒujī. 11:00 yǐhòu jiù méi wèntí le.
transcript.english: Note! Wednesday 8:00–11:00 a.m.: the library internet can't be used, and the computers can't go online either. Students who need to go online, please use your own phones. After 11:00 it will be fine.

prompt.traditional: 星期三上午，圖書館的網路有幾個小時不能用？
prompt.simplified: 星期三上午，图书馆的网路有几个小时不能用？
prompt.pinyin: Xīngqísān shàngwǔ, túshūguǎn de wǎnglù yǒu jǐ ge xiǎoshí bù néng yòng?
prompt.english: On Wednesday morning, for how many hours can't the library internet be used?

questions.why: From 8:00 to 11:00 is three hours (三個小時). 8 is the start time, not the length; 8, 9, 10 and 11 are four clock times but only three hours.

versions.alt: A museum exhibition room; the wall clock shows ten to five. On the left a woman guide points at a big picture of an old ship and talks to four students. On the right a boy talks loudly on his phone, and the two visitors next to him turn to look at him.

prompt.traditional: 那個男生在打電話，說話很＿＿，旁邊的人都在看他。
prompt.simplified: 那个男生在打电话，说话很＿＿，旁边的人都在看他。

answer.traditional: 那個男生在打電話，說話很大聲，旁邊的人都在看他。
answer.simplified: 那个男生在打电话，说话很大声，旁边的人都在看他。
answer.pinyin: Nàge nánshēng zài dǎ diànhuà, shuōhuà hěn dàshēng, pángbiān de rén dōu zài kàn tā.
answer.english: That boy is on the phone, talking very loudly, and the people next to him are looking at him.

questions.why: In the picture he talks loudly into his phone and the people next to him (旁邊的人) turn to look: 大聲 means loud. 安靜 is the opposite, and 準時 (on time) says nothing about talking.

prompt.traditional: 那位小姐在跟學生＿＿這張圖片。
prompt.simplified: 那位小姐在跟学生＿＿这张图片。

answer.traditional: 那位小姐在跟學生介紹這張圖片。
answer.simplified: 那位小姐在跟学生介绍这张图片。
answer.pinyin: Nà wèi xiǎojiě zài gēn xuéshēng jièshào zhè zhāng túpiàn.
answer.english: That woman is telling the students about this picture.

questions.why: 跟學生介紹 means to introduce something to the students: she explains the picture. You 參觀 a place, not a picture, and 排隊 (line up) takes no object.

prompt.traditional: 這張圖片很有趣，請你也看＿＿。
prompt.simplified: 这张图片很有趣，请你也看＿＿。

answer.traditional: 這張圖片很有趣，請你也看看。
answer.simplified: 这张图片很有趣，请你也看看。
answer.pinyin: Zhè zhāng túpiàn hěn yǒuqù, qǐng nǐ yě kànkan.
answer.english: This picture is interesting. Please have a look too.

questions.why: 看看 repeats the verb for a light “have a look” in a polite request with 請. 看到 and 看過 say what someone saw or has seen; they do not make a request.

versions.alt: A museum exhibition room; the wall clock shows ten to five. On the left a woman guide points at a big picture of an old ship and talks to four students. On the right a boy talks loudly on his phone, and the two visitors next to him turn to look at him.

prompt.traditional: 博物館五點關門，現在四點五十分，＿＿關門了。
prompt.simplified: 博物馆五点关门，现在四点五十分，＿＿关门了。

answer.traditional: 博物館五點關門，現在四點五十分，就要關門了。
answer.simplified: 博物馆五点关门，现在四点五十分，就要关门了。
answer.pinyin: Bówùguǎn wǔ diǎn guānmén, xiànzài sì diǎn wǔshí fēn, jiù yào guānmén le.
answer.english: The museum closes at five. It's ten to five now, so it will close soon.

questions.why: It closes at five (五點關門) and it is only 4:50, so it has not closed yet: 就要……了 means it will close soon. 已經 and 剛剛 would mean it has closed already.

prompt.traditional: 從四點半到現在，那個男生打電話打了二十＿＿了。
prompt.simplified: 从四点半到现在，那个男生打电话打了二十＿＿了。

answer.traditional: 從四點半到現在，那個男生打電話打了二十分鐘了。
answer.simplified: 从四点半到现在，那个男生打电话打了二十分钟了。
answer.pinyin: Cóng sì diǎn bàn dào xiànzài, nàge nánshēng dǎ diànhuà dǎ le èrshí fēnzhōng le.
answer.english: From half past four until now, that boy has been on the phone for twenty minutes.

questions.why: How long goes after the repeated verb: 打電話打了二十分鐘, from 4:30 to the 4:50 on the clock. 點 is a clock time and 號 a date, not a length of time.

prompt.traditional: 那位小姐在說這張圖片的故事，我們一起去聽＿＿，好嗎？
prompt.simplified: 那位小姐在说这张图片的故事，我们一起去听＿＿，好吗？

answer.traditional: 那位小姐在說這張圖片的故事，我們一起去聽聽，好嗎？
answer.simplified: 那位小姐在说这张图片的故事，我们一起去听听，好吗？
answer.pinyin: Nà wèi xiǎojiě zài shuō zhè zhāng túpiàn de gùshì, wǒmen yìqǐ qù tīngting, hǎo ma?
answer.english: That woman is telling the story of this picture. Shall we go and have a listen?

questions.why: 聽聽 repeats the verb for a light “have a listen” in a suggestion (……，好嗎？). 聽說 means to hear it said, and 聽過 is for past experience; neither makes a suggestion.

passage.traditional: 星期六我{1}妹妹去參觀博物館。我們從捷運站走十分鐘{2}到了。博物館九點開門，我們八點半到，在門口等了{3}。妹妹很喜歡那裡的畫，看了兩個小時還不想走。我們{4}捷運回家的時候，她說下個月還想再來。
passage.simplified: 星期六我{1}妹妹去参观博物馆。我们从捷运站走十分钟{2}到了。博物馆九点开门，我们八点半到，在门口等了{3}。妹妹很喜欢那里的画，看了两个小时还不想走。我们{4}捷运回家的时候，她说下个月还想再来。
passage.pinyin: Xīngqíliù wǒ dài mèimei qù cānguān bówùguǎn. Wǒmen cóng jiéyùn zhàn zǒu shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le. Bówùguǎn jiǔ diǎn kāimén, wǒmen bā diǎn bàn dào, zài ménkǒu děng le bàn ge xiǎoshí. Mèimei hěn xǐhuān nàlǐ de huà, kàn le liǎng ge xiǎoshí hái bù xiǎng zǒu. Wǒmen zuò jiéyùn huí jiā de shíhòu, tā shuō xià ge yuè hái xiǎng zài lái.
passage.english: On Saturday I took my little sister to visit a museum. From the MRT station we walked ten minutes, and we were there. The museum opens at nine; we got there at eight thirty and waited at the door for half an hour. My sister loved the paintings there; after two hours she still didn't want to leave. When we took the MRT home, she said she wanted to come again next month.

questions.why: 帶 + a person means to take someone along: 我帶妹妹去 means I take my sister there.
就 links an action to its easy result: walk ten minutes from the station, and then (就) you are there.
From 8:30 to 9:00 they waited: 等了半個小時, half an hour. The length of time goes after the verb.
坐捷運 means to take the MRT. 往 needs a direction after it, like 往右.

passage.traditional: {1}我的手機不能上網，我很擔心。同學說：「你先等十分鐘，{2}可以上網了。」十分鐘以後，我的手機真的能上網了。我馬上{3}了一{4}電子郵件給老師。
passage.simplified: {1}我的手机不能上网，我很担心。同学说：「你先等十分钟，{2}可以上网了。」十分钟以后，我的手机真的能上网了。我马上{3}了一{4}电子邮件给老师。
passage.pinyin: Gānggāng wǒ de shǒujī bù néng shàngwǎng, wǒ hěn dānxīn. Tóngxué shuō: “Nǐ xiān děng shí fēnzhōng, jiù kěyǐ shàngwǎng le.” Shí fēnzhōng yǐhòu, wǒ de shǒujī zhēnde néng shàngwǎng le. Wǒ mǎshàng jì le yì fēng diànzǐ yóujiàn gěi lǎoshī.
passage.english: A little while ago my phone couldn't go online, and I was worried. A classmate said, “Wait ten minutes first, and then you can go online.” Ten minutes later, my phone really could go online. Right away I sent an email to my teacher.

questions.why: 剛剛 means a little while ago: it opens the story and says when the phone could not go online.
就 gives the easy result: wait ten minutes first, and then (就) you can go online.
寄 means to send: 寄了一封電子郵件 means sent an email.
Emails and letters take 封: 一封電子郵件. 張 is for flat things like tickets and pictures.

text.traditional:
宜文：
我現在在宿舍寫作業，晚上七點要去圖書館。妳要不要跟我一起去？
友美
text.simplified:
宜文：
我现在在宿舍写作业，晚上七点要去图书馆。你要不要跟我一起去？
友美
text.pinyin: Yíwén: Wǒ xiànzài zài sùshè xiě zuòyè, wǎnshàng qī diǎn yào qù túshūguǎn. Nǐ yào bu yào gēn wǒ yìqǐ qù? Yǒuměi
text.english: Yiwen: I'm doing my homework in the dorm now, and at seven this evening I'm going to the library. Do you want to come with me? Youmei

prompt.traditional: 友美現在在哪裡？
prompt.simplified: 友美现在在哪里？
prompt.pinyin: Yǒuměi xiànzài zài nǎlǐ?
prompt.english: Where is Youmei now?

questions.why: 現在在宿舍寫作業: she is in the dorm now. The library (圖書館) is where she is going at seven this evening.

text.traditional:
中明：
這個星期天，要是天氣不冷，我們就去騎腳踏車；要是很冷，我們就去咖啡廳喝下午茶。你覺得怎麼樣？
國安
text.simplified:
中明：
这个星期天，要是天气不冷，我们就去骑脚踏车；要是很冷，我们就去咖啡厅喝下午茶。你觉得怎么样？
国安
text.pinyin: Zhōngmíng: Zhège xīngqítiān, yàoshì tiānqì bù lěng, wǒmen jiù qù qí jiǎotàchē; yàoshì hěn lěng, wǒmen jiù qù kāfēitīng hē xiàwǔ chá. Nǐ juéde zěnmeyàng? Guó'ān
text.english: Zhongming: This Sunday, if it isn't cold, let's go for a bike ride; if it's very cold, let's go to a café for afternoon tea. What do you think? Guo'an

prompt.traditional: 要是星期天很冷，他們要做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 要是星期天很冷，他们要做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Yàoshì xīngqítiān hěn lěng, tāmen yào zuò shénme?
prompt.english: If it's very cold on Sunday, what will they do?

questions.why: 要是很冷，我們就去咖啡廳喝下午茶: if it is cold, then afternoon tea. The bike ride is for a day that isn't cold.
